description: Reference example: keep a UBI 9 minimal or micro base image override, pinned by rebuild tag and digest (BASE_IMAGE=<image>:9.<minor>-<build>@sha256:<digest>), up to date, and leave the plugin-managed Dockerfile to plugin releases.

customManagers.description: BASE_IMAGE=<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> in CI configuration, scripts or gradle.properties

packageRules.description: Red Hat tags each rebuild 9.<minor>-<build>, and moves 9.<minor>, latest and a bare build number along with it: compare rebuild tags only, the build as the patch.
The ARG BASE_IMAGE default in a java-app or node-app Dockerfile is rewritten by each plugin release: update the plugin, not the line.
